about: Workflow files the code-view parser (U.2, #166) must refuse, and the errors it must report for each: the code and the 1-based range, never the message. Lines count line feeds only; endColumn is exclusive.

cases.name: unknown-stage-call
cases.about: A stage call the closed grammar does not have: review(…) where a terminal is needsReview(…).

cases.name: malformed-predicate
cases.about: A trigger condition written with a comparison operator rather than one of the grammar's tests.

cases.name: stray-statement
cases.about: A statement outside the header and defineLoop, which a parser that ran the file would execute.

cases.name: missing-position
cases.about: A stage with no node line in the layout block, so nothing says where the canvas draws it.

cases.name: three-mistakes
cases.about: A name the SDK does not export, a missing comma and an option a terminal does not take, reported from one parse.
